jobs.title: Analyst (Intern), AI Development
jobs.eligibility: Studying computing, AI, data science, information engineering, software engineering or a related subject. Basic programming and practical AI knowledge preferred.
jobs.summary: Develop and test AI applications, contribute software features, and support generative AI and data projects, demonstrations and documentation.
jobs.caveat: Six-month January–June 2027 commitment. Weekly hours and remote arrangements are unspecified. Employer says recruitment continues until filled; availability is not independently confirmed.
jobs.evidence_note: Official job detail includes reference DTD/11076, a six-month Jan–Jun 2027 term and Apply now. Official Digital Branch index dates the listing 6 Nov 2026.

jobs.title: Intern, HealthTech and TCM
jobs.eligibility: Bachelor's student in health, medicine, project management, business, computing or AI. Prior internship/part-time experience requested; English and Chinese required. AI and UI/UX familiarity is advantageous.
jobs.summary: Research healthcare and Chinese medicine markets and regulation; support consultancy proposals, stakeholder events, and AI-assisted analysis and project materials.
jobs.caveat: Six months, January–June 2027. The experience criterion says '2-3 relevant intern or part-time working experience' without clarifying the unit; confirm with the employer. Vacancy availability remains unconfirmed.
jobs.evidence_note: Official detail SMD/11077 states the 2027 term and lists an application link. Employer's Digital Branch index shows 7 Nov 2026. No exact pay or weekly schedule.

jobs.title: Intern, Media and Communications
jobs.eligibility: Current student or recent graduate in communications, journalism, PR, marketing, business, social sciences, digital media, languages or related studies. English and Chinese, including Cantonese and Putonghua. Relevant portfolio examples are advantageous.
jobs.summary: Monitor media and industry news, research communications projects, prepare content, and support publicity events using digital and AI tools with human fact-checking.
jobs.caveat: Programme ends 31 March 2027; start date, total duration and weekly hours are unspecified. Employer asks applications within a week of posting and says recruitment continues until filled.
jobs.evidence_note: Official detail MAC/11132 contains duties, student/recent-graduate eligibility, programme end date and Apply now. Employer's Digital Branch index dates it 4 Nov 2026.

jobs.title: Actuarial / Insurance Product Intern (2026 H2)
jobs.eligibility: Year 3–4 undergraduate in a quantitative subject such as actuarial science, quantitative finance, computing or mathematics; strong Year 2 students may be considered. Analytical skills and Microsoft Office proficiency; Python advantageous.
jobs.summary: Work across health insurance pricing, product development, market research and financial analysis alongside actuarial, engineering and design teams.
jobs.caveat: Full-time for six months. Listing is labelled 2026 H2; exact available start dates and remaining places need employer confirmation. No exact pay listed.
jobs.evidence_note: Employer internship index links to this role. The job page states Hong Kong, Hybrid, Internship, six months full-time and shows an application form.

jobs.title: Finance Intern (Part-time)
jobs.eligibility: Currently pursuing accounting, finance or a related degree; analytical skills, Excel proficiency, communication skills and attention to detail.
jobs.summary: Support accounting operations, financial statements, budgets, forecasting and variance analysis at a health insurance startup.
jobs.caveat: At least three days each week, not an exact three-day schedule. Specific duration, pay, start date and work mode are unspecified. The employer labels its recruitment year-round; availability still needs confirmation.
jobs.evidence_note: Official internship index links to this role. Detail page explicitly gives part-time, at least three days per week, degree eligibility and an application form.

jobs.title: Investment Analytics Intern
jobs.eligibility: Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's in computing, software engineering, data science, statistics or related studies. Python and MySQL proficiency; interest in blockchain and digital assets.
jobs.summary: Build investment dashboards and data pipelines, analyse on-chain data, and develop analytics tools for a blockchain-focused asset manager.
jobs.caveat: Undated employer listing. Hong Kong or Toronto placement, start date, hours, duration and pay require confirmation; the page requests in-person teamwork.
jobs.evidence_note: Employer careers page explicitly lists Investment Analytics Intern in Hong Kong or Toronto, responsibilities, student eligibility and an Apply now contact.

jobs.title: AI-Native Growth, Marketing & Operations Intern
jobs.eligibility: Broad business, marketing, economics, design, computing and interdisciplinary backgrounds considered. English research/writing, strong execution and willingness to learn AI tools; Mandarin or Korean is optional.
jobs.summary: Work with the founder on campaign research, AI-assisted workflows, market intelligence, partnership materials and short-form video experiments across a venture portfolio.
jobs.caveat: Flexible duration is eight weeks to twelve months, so no single duration is assigned. Weekly hours, compensation and start date are unspecified. Remote eligibility and current availability require confirmation.
jobs.evidence_note: Official careers page marks the role Open Position, specifies Hong Kong base and hybrid/remote-friendly work, and provides an application route with CV and portfolio.
jobs.duration_normalization: 8 weeks is approximately 2 months for filtering.

jobs.title: Data Engineer / Data Scientist, Internship Program
jobs.eligibility: Bachelor's Year 3 or above in computing, engineering, IT or related studies. Python and SQL required; Linux, networking and databases expected. Data crawling, AWS, C++ or Java experience advantageous.
jobs.summary: Develop data acquisition pipelines, improve data quality and analyse datasets for a quantitative trading firm's research work.
jobs.caveat: Undated role linked from the employer's Current Openings page. That page also contains older cohort-labelled jobs; confirm this vacancy's intake, start date and availability before applying.
jobs.evidence_note: Opened the employer's careers index and linked job detail. Detail explicitly states Hong Kong, Internship and entry level, lists requirements, and provides an application link.

jobs.title: Venture Associate (Operations & Special Projects)
jobs.eligibility: Life sciences, business or related degree; English and Mandarin. Main associate specification asks for 1–2 years in project management, strategy or operations. Internship eligibility is not separately defined.
jobs.salary_text: Main associate listing says competitive salary; internship compensation is unspecified.
jobs.summary: Support operations, market research, strategic projects, marketing and business development in a life-sciences venture-building studio.
jobs.caveat: Primarily an associate role with internships available only for selected candidates. Page shows Aug 8 without a year. Confirm internship availability, student eligibility, pay and schedule.
jobs.evidence_note: Official page explicitly allows internships for selected candidates and states Hong Kong. The main experience requirement and missing posting year prevent treating it as a confirmed student vacancy.

jobs.title: Business Scientist Internship (6-month full-time) — January 2027
jobs.eligibility: The application asks for graduation year (2026, 2027 or 2028), language fluency and work permit status. Detailed academic and technical requirements need review.
jobs.salary_text: Not published in the retrieved application page.
jobs.summary: A six-month full-time placement in the Hong Kong Data Science & AI team beginning January 2027; detailed responsibilities need review.
jobs.caveat: Official application page is accessible, but the full description returned 403. Title specifies a six-month internship while ATS metadata says Permanent position; confirm terms before relying on it.
jobs.evidence_note: Opened employer-hosted Lever application form showing exact title, Hong Kong, Data Science & AI, Hybrid and application questions. The underlying full-description URL could not be retrieved.
